en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a three‑story, rectangular villa with classical detailing, shuttered windows, and a flat roofline. The house is partially covered by climbing vines along a pergola at ground level and is set behind a low fence. Mature trees line a path or quiet street running along the front of the property. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image itself.
